## 1. 本季度收入同比增长了多少？

**计算过程：**

| 项目 | FY26 Q4（本季） | FY25 Q4（上年同期） | 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $39,306 百万 | $29,878 百万 | financial_statements.txt（Q4 表格）、metrics.txt（第 11 行） |

同比增长率 = ($39,306 − $29,878) ÷ $29,878 = $9,428 ÷ $29,878 ≈ **0.3156 → 32%**（四舍五入）

- **报表口径（As Reported）：32%**（press_release.txt 第 3115 行、metrics.txt 第 11 行均明确标注）
- **恒定汇率口径（Constant Currency）：31%**（transcript.txt 第 24808 字符处、metrics.txt 均标注）

> press_release.txt 第 3115 行原文："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"

## 2. 管理层在电话会上把增长归因于哪些因素？

以下全部来自 transcript.txt 第 24808–24845 字符区间（管理层对 Intelligent Cloud 分部的季度评论），逐条引用：

**A. Azure and other cloud services（增长 43%）**

1. **"Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity."** 
   —— 需求持续超过可用容量。

2. **"Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity."**
   —— 增速超预期，原因是 CPU/GPU 机群效率提升，以及流程改进使新产能更早交付。

3. **"That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."**
   —— 本季额外的 Azure 产能被快速变现。

4. **"Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."**
   —— 受益于 GitHub Copilot 消耗超预期，源于 6 月商业模式调整（定价与使用量和价值对齐）。

**B. On-premises server 业务（同比基本持平，恒定汇率 −1%）**

5. **"Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."**
   —— 续约带来的合同组合内本期确认收入更高，使结果超预期。

## 3. 哪些是已发生的事实，哪些是前瞻性表述？

| # | 归因 | 性质 | 区分依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" | **已发生的事实** | "continues to exceed" 为现在进行时，描述本季观察到的持续状态；transcript 语境为对 Q4 已发生结果的回顾性总结 |
| 2 | "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity" | **已发生的事实** | 用过去式 "was ahead of expectations"，且 "efficiency gains" 和 "process improvements" 是已实现的、驱动本季结果的因素；"enable earlier delivery" 指已交付的新产能 |
| 3 | "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized" | **已发生的事实** | "was quickly monetized" 为过去被动式，明确指本季发生的变现行为 |
| 4 | "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" | **已发生的事实** | "benefited from" 为过去式；"June business model change" 是已发生事件（FY26 Q4 内完成）；"stronger-than-expected" 是对已实现结果的回溯性评价 |
| 5 | "Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts" | **已发生的事实** | "were ahead of expectations" 为过去式，描述本季实际表现；"renewals" 是已完成的续约 |

**总结：** 以上 5 条全部为**已发生的事实**。本季度 transcript 中关于 Intelligent Cloud 的评论没有包含任何"forward-looking / 前瞻性"表述——管理层在回顾部分仅使用了描述已实现结果的时态（过去式、现在进行时）。前瞻性表述出现在后续 **outlook（展望）** 部分（例如 "we expect"、"we continue to expect" 等句式），但不属于本季度已实现增长的归因。

> 区分依据：英语时态和措辞——过去式（was/were + 过去分词）和现在进行时（continues to + 动词原形）用于描述已发生或持续的状态；will / 将来时态或 "we expect / we continue to expect" 等用于前瞻性表述。在本段 transcript 中未见任何前瞻性归因语句。
